title: Rail Container Survey System
tagline: Reads every container number on a rake, automatically.

meta.title: Rail Container Survey System | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Reads every container number on a rake, automatically.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Manually verifying container position, count, and ISO codes on a rake is slow and error-prone, and mistakes here cascade into logistics delays.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Computer vision tracks each container's position while OCR extracts its number and code, generating a report automatically at every entry and exit.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Accurate, auditable container records with far less manual survey work.
